Defined in: experiments/star-field/engine/bodies/weather.ts:284

Builds the living cloud deck + applies the matching surface shadow — a lit MeshStandardNodeMaterial so the deck takes real sun shading (bright limb, dark night side, true terminator) instead of the old additive white wash. surfaceMat gets a colorNode multiplying the day-side diffuse by 1 − SHADOW·density so thick weather visibly dims the ground beneath it. The shared fxTime uniform drives field evolution (updateFx writes it once per frame).
